name: Hooker Valley Track
why: A gentle valley walk over three swing bridges to Hooker Lake, with Aoraki/Mount Cook straight ahead and, in summer, icebergs on the water.
book: Free. White Horse Hill car park, at the end of Hooker Valley Road 5 minutes from the village, costs $2.50 per half hour or $25 a day (cards only).
water: Treated drinking water at the White Horse Hill Campground shelter at the start; toilets there and 15 minutes past the second bridge.
dangers: Weather changes fast: strong wind, heavy rain and cold at any time of year.
Icy and very slippery in shaded parts in winter: microspikes and poles.
The lakes are about 3 °C: stay out of the water, off frozen lakes and off the icebergs.
turnaround: In strong wind or heavy rain, turn back at the first swing bridge, just after the Mueller Lake lookout.

points.name: White Horse Hill car park
points.note: Past side tracks to Freda's Rock and the Alpine Memorial; the Mueller Lake lookout is before the first bridge.

points.name: Second Hooker swing bridge
points.note: The new 189 m bridge over the Hooker River (opened July 2026), the longest suspension bridge in New Zealand.

points.name: Hooker Lake
points.note: The track ends at the lake shore under Aoraki/Mount Cook. Return the same way.
